script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Golden Plastic ji — main IndiaMART se bol raha hoon. Aapka account 892 din purana hai, lekin pichle poore 30 dinon mein ek bhi enquiry nahi aayi aur aapne platform open bhi nahi kiya — yeh dekh ke mujhe genuinely concern hua, isliye call kiya.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai, seedha poochhna chahta hoon — kya aapko lagta hai ki aapke products ke buyers is platform pe hain hi nahi, ya koi aur wajah hai jaise pricing issue, product listing ka problem, ya phir business mein koi change aaya hai recently?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important data point share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 52 hai, jo 60 se neeche hai, matlab aapki listing buyers ke search results mein bahut kam dikh rahi hai. Aur is waqt aapke segment mein demand tier 'Red' hai — market mein buyers ki activity flat hai — toh jo thodi bhi visibility milti, woh bhi aap miss kar rahe hain kyunki catalog optimize nahi hai.
script_parts.action: Chaliye abhi is call pe ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog screen pe open karta hoon aur aapke top 2-3 products ke titles aur keywords ek saath review karte hain, taaki CQS score 60 ke upar le jaayein aur jo bhi organic traffic aa raha hai woh aap tak pahunche.
script_parts.close: Bhai, main aaj ki changes ka ek short summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon — aap ek hafte baad khud check karein ki impressions badhe ya nahi, phir hum decide karein aage kya karna hai. Koi pressure nahi, bas ek fair chance dete hain platform ko.

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, Golden Plastic ji — I'm calling from IndiaMART. Your account is 892 days old, but in the last 30 days there has been zero enquiries and zero active days on the platform — seeing that genuinely concerned me, which is why I'm reaching out today.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I want to ask you directly — do you feel that buyers for your products simply aren't present on this platform, or is there another reason, like a pricing issue, a product listing problem, or some recent change in your business?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a specific data point — your CQS score is currently 52, which is below the 60 threshold, meaning your listings are getting very low visibility in buyer search results. On top of that, your demand tier is 'Red' right now — buyer activity in your market segment is flat — so even the limited organic traffic that exists is not reaching you because the catalog isn't optimized.
script_parts_en.action: Let's do one concrete thing together right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and we'll review the titles and keywords on your top 2-3 products together, so we can push your CQS score above 60 and make sure whatever buyer traffic does exist actually finds you.
script_parts_en.close: Bhai, I'll send you a short WhatsApp summary of today's changes — please check after one week whether impressions have improved, and then we can decide together what the next step should be. No pressure at all, let's just give the platform a fair chance.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
